h: The Peace of Shabbos Sustains Creation and Its Blessings

p: In the holy Zohar on this parsha
כַּד בָּרָא קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא עָלְמָא
When Hakadosh Baruch Hu created the world,
of the upper and the lower beings;
And it is written in the glosses
of Rabbi Chaim Vital, of blessed memory:
And according to this one must understand
what is written in the holy Zohar,
Hakadosh Baruch Hu created in the world,
and it does not say 'in six days.'"
the sixth day corresponds to Yesod,
yet here it says of Shabbos
that on the first day it is written (Bereishis 1:1):
for the purpose of creation was
that the glory of His Kingship,
blessed be His Name, be revealed
and this is through the creation of man,
who was created on the sixth day,
'And the tzaddik is the foundation of the world'";
for the sake of one tzaddik
'And the tzaddik is the foundation of the world.'"
And this is what the holy Zohar says,
and that is the sixth day,
on which Adam HaRishon was created.
the tzaddik, foundation of the world;
And in the end it will become clear
of all the seed of Yisrael
at the entry of the day of Shabbos
and behold, it was very good";
and everything that is the opposite of good,
may you find favor before Me
just as you have found favor before Me
And it is in the manner of
מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קפד, א)
which comes out from within darkness,
which comes out from within evil."
And this is what it says (Tehillim 139:16):
and He has one among them":
"this is the day of Shabbos for Yisrael,"
that is, that then, on Shabbos,
the glory of the Kingship of Heaven;
and this is the purpose of
the making of heaven and earth.

p: and likewise the root of blessings
and "Tziyon" has the numerical value of "Yosef."
the seven Mussafim of the festivals
"corresponding to Tzaddik, foundation of the world,
and is called the Mussaf of Shabbos";
And likewise all the praise of the angels
And this is what is written
(זוֹהַר חָדָשׁ בְּרֵאשִׁית יז, רֵישׁ עַמּוּד ב)
(Zohar Chadash, Bereishis 17b, top of the amud):
and there was no glory and praise before Him
and there broke forth song and praise,
the upper and lower beings, etc."
And so the Men of the Great Assembly
And this is what is said
in the holy Zohar mentioned above:
of the upper and the lower beings."
for all the bounty of this world
which is above the Name Havayah,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג י, ב)
And this is what it says (Shmuel I 1:10):
And all the bestowals of blessing
and through the day of Shabbos,
to the holy Field of Apples";
and in the blessing of Yosef
they shall be on the head of Yosef, etc."
And the drawing down of holiness
and the drawing down of blessing
is from the tip of the Yud,
a little before this, it says:
is the Name of Hakadosh Baruch Hu,
are the words of the Torah,
because they are the holy Name;
engages in the holy Name, etc."
And so it is written in the holy Zohar
And this is what it says:
that they correspond to the four worlds
in the secret of the Torah of Atzilus,
which is called the Torah of Above;
in the secret of the Torah of Asiyah.
for he expounded the pasuk "more desirable"
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ שַׁבָּת פח, סוֹף עַמּוּד ב)
(as they said, Shabbos 88b, end of the amud);
to the totality of Knesses Yisrael,
corresponds to the Torah of Asiyah.
as corresponding to the Torah of Beriah
he did not write a reason,
